newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 549 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 549 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 549 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 21 wheat contracts, 225 corn, 267 soybean, 17 soymeal, 6 soyoil and 13 rice futures contracts traded. There were nil options traded overnight.

The overnight trend for corn was one to to 1-1/4 cents per bushel higher, soybeans down 1/2 to 4-3/4 cents, wheat down 1/2 cent, soymeal down $1.10 per ton, soyoil up 0.05 cent per lb, and rice up 14 cents.
